_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
U na Mmoki {player_id} mo kgweding ya Tic Tac Toe.
Mosebetsi wa hao ke wa hlola mashelelo a mabedi (mo tšweu, mo tšepele, kapa ka moja) kwingong.
Hapele ha hao, u se ke ua kgetha nomoro ya tšwele (0-8) u e nyakang go hloma tšwele la hao la bobedi.
Ejesele, '[4]' e u fa tšwele la hao kwingong ya kgolo ya boro.
Ele Mmoki {player_id}, u tla ba {symbol}, ha u na mmoki wa hao a ba {opponent_symbol}.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ho falla ho hlahisitsoeng ha hoa latela mokhoa o nepahetseng.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} hase sele e nepahetseng. E tlameha ho ba pakeng tsa 0 le 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Sele {cell} e se ntse e na le motho.

game_action.placed: Mmoki {player_id} o hlomeile semelo sa hae ({symbol}) kwingong {cell}.
